resources.title: Attached
resources.author: Amir Levine & Rachel Heller
resources.description: The definitive guide to adult attachment theory. Explains anxious, avoidant, and secure styles in plain language and why we are drawn to people who feel familiar, not safe.

resources.title: Trauma Rewired
resources.author: Jennifer Wallace & Elisabeth Kristof
resources.description: A research-backed podcast on how trauma lives in the body and how the nervous system can heal. Particularly useful for understanding why no-contact feels physically painful.

resources.title: Psykologiguiden
resources.description: Swedish directory for finding a licensed therapist. Searchable by location, specialisation, and insurance. If you are ready to talk to someone, this is a good place to start. (Swedish)

resources.title: The Body Keeps the Score
resources.author: Bessel van der Kolk
resources.description: A landmark book on how trauma shapes the body and mind — and the range of approaches that can help. Particularly relevant if the relationship involved emotional or psychological abuse.

resources.title: We Can Do Hard Things
resources.author: Glennon Doyle
resources.description: Honest, warm conversations about difficult human experiences. Not specifically about breakups, but consistently useful for anyone going through something hard.

resources.title: Psychology Today Therapist Finder
resources.description: International directory of licensed therapists, searchable by issue, therapy type, and location. A practical starting point if you are considering professional support.

resources.title: Why Does He Do That?
resources.author: Lundy Bancroft
resources.description: A clear-eyed look at controlling and abusive relationship dynamics — written for people who are still trying to understand what happened. Widely recommended by therapists.
